_doc: Frozen power standard for DAX W1. See dax/memo/PI_DECISION_D3_2026-08-18.md. This file is the ONLY source of the pass bar. Nothing may recompute it from the analysis sample; freeze_power_standard.py fills it once from the frozen pre-event CPS extract and refuses to overwrite without --force.

frozen_window.rationale: Ends the month before the first eligible event (GPT4_LAUNCH, 2023-03), so the constant cannot contain any post-treatment information.

benchmark.quantity: relative decline in EMPLOYMENT (headcount), not payroll
benchmark.measured_in: ADP administrative payroll data — 'payroll' names the DATA SOURCE, not the outcome variable. This distinction is what M2 flagged.
benchmark.population: workers ages 22-25 in the most AI-exposed occupations
benchmark.citation: Brynjolfsson, E., B. Chandar, and R. Chen. 2025. "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence." Working paper.

benchmark.version_note: Independent source audit on 2026-08-19 verified 0.13 in the authored August 26 2025 document and 0.16 in the official November 13 2025 revision. It found no authored paper/proposal version, page, section, table, or exact quotation stating 0.19. The PI expressed a preference for 0.19 on 2026-08-18, but selecting 0.13 merely because it is available would override that unresolved version choice. Because 0.19 loosens the pass bar by about 46 percent relative to 0.13, the executable benchmark remains null and unfrozen pending an exact 0.19 locator or a signed amendment selecting a sourced version.
benchmark.locator_caveat: No exact 0.19 statement was located in the primary Canaries paper/proposal materials inspected on 2026-08-19. The 0.13 and 0.16 versions are verifiable but neither authorizes silently substituting a different PI-selected benchmark. Upgrade locator_status to VERIFIED only with a dated exact 0.19 locator or a signed amendment selecting a sourced version.
